Author: zbl1998-sdjn
Message:
release: stabilize host test gate + harden teardown/CSP/CORS, persist auth, bound exec output

Audit-3 P0/P1 + four-item work:
- test gate: scope discovery to test/*.test.js (exclude fixtures), --test-isolation=process; closeTestServer helper; server.shutdown() now closeAllConnections()+stop scheduler. test:host now exits 0 (360/360), test:ui 34/34.
- MCP leak fix: connector-API clients now registered in server._mcpClients so closeMcp/shutdown reaps child processes (was leaking, hung the host).
- path-policy: sensitive-segment check scoped below trusted root; canonicalizePath resolves nearest existing ancestor (fixes Windows 8.3 short-name false 'escaped').
- auth store persisted to SQLite (users/sessions/guest survive restart), graceful in-memory fallback.
- exec-child + command-runner: streaming memory-bounded output cap (no heap blowup on high-output commands).
- audit-events -> JsonlWriter rotation; CSP object-src 'none' (PDF preview via iframe); CORS rejects Origin: null; legacy app-run-events.js EventSource -> token fetch-SSE.
- audit:mvp --strict rejects stale (>10min) / wrong-repoRoot evidence.
- code-signing pipeline (scripts/sign-windows.ps1); .env.example; .gitignore covers sidecar exe / sqlite / scratch.
